request.style: English, smoky female jazz voice, upright bass, brushed drums, piano, saxophone, melancholic, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He was twenty-three when he took the throne
His mother Hamutal from Libnah was known
Three short months in Jerusalem he stayed
Evil in the Lord's sight was the way

[Chorus]
Pharaoh Neco came to take his place
Riblah became his prison and his race
A hundred talents of silver and gold
The heavy weight of the tribute told

[Verse]
He could not reign in Jerusalem's gate
Imprisoned in the land of Hamath state
His brother Eliakim rose to the crown
Jehoiakim was the name he received now

[Chorus]
Pharaoh Neco came to take his place
Riblah became his prison and his race
A hundred talents of silver and gold
The heavy weight of the tribute told

[Bridge]
To Egypt he was taken by force
And there in the distance he found his course
Jehoahaz died far from his home
In the shadow of the pharaoh's throne

[Chorus]
Pharaoh Neco came to take his place
Riblah became his prison and his race
A hundred talents of silver and gold
The heavy weight of the tribute told

[Outro]
Three months of rule and then the end
A king displaced by a foreign friend
